info.title: Rotaract South Asia Analytics API
info.description:
Public, high-performance REST API and Model Context Protocol (MCP) server providing open analytics data for Rotaract and Rotary across South Asia (Zones 4, 5, 6, and 7; 44 districts; 2,870+ clubs).

### Model Context Protocol (MCP) Integration
This service includes a Model Context Protocol (MCP) server for direct use by AI assistants (Cursor, Claude Desktop, Antigravity, VS Code):
- **Local Stdio Command:** `npm run mcp` or `node scripts/mcp_server.js`
- **Remote HTTP Endpoint:** `POST https://insights.rsmda.org/api/mcp` (JSON-RPC 2.0)
- **Available AI Tools (14 tools):** `get_summary`, `get_leaderboards`, `get_districts`, `get_district_insights`, `get_zone_summary`, `search_clubs`, `get_club_profile`, `get_new_clubs`, `find_compliance_risks`, `find_dual_risk_clubs`, `get_interact_analytics`, `find_rotary_opportunities`, `get_foundation_giving`, `get_worldwide_rankings`.

All endpoints are open, unauthenticated, and CORS-enabled.

get.description: Returns high-level aggregate KPI metrics for South Asia or scoped to a specific zone.
Returns top rankings across South Asia for largest clubs (by membership), top TRF donors, highest arrears dues, and top districts. Supports optional filtering by district, zone, base, and category.

parameters.name: district
parameters.description: Scope rankings to a specific 4-digit district (e.g. '3000')

parameters.name: zone
parameters.description: Scope rankings to a specific zone (e.g. 'Zone 5' or '5')

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Number of top records to return (1-50, default 10)

get.description: Returns all 4 South Asia zones with high-level statistics and district lists.
Returns detailed metrics, district breakdowns, and district leadership for a specific zone.
Returns all 44 districts with key metrics and leadership contacts.

parameters.name: sortBy
parameters.description: Sort field (totalClubs, members, arrearsClubs, outstanding, trf, newClubs, interactGrowth, district)

get.description: Returns full performance profile, leadership, and issue counts for a specific district.
Full-text search and multi-facet filtering across 2,870+ Rotaract clubs in South Asia.

parameters.name: q
parameters.description: Search keyword matching club name, club ID, sponsor club, or country

parameters.name: isAtRisk
parameters.description: Filter by high termination risk status (>= $75 USD outstanding)

parameters.name: isNoOfficers
parameters.description: Filter by missing reported club officers status

parameters.name: sortOrder
parameters.description: Sort order ('desc' for largest/highest first, 'asc' for lowest/alphabetical)

parameters.name: minMembers
parameters.description: Filter clubs with at least this many members

parameters.name: maxMembers
parameters.description: Filter clubs with at most this many members

parameters.name: minOutstanding
parameters.description: Filter clubs with outstanding dues in INR at least this amount

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Number of records to return (1-100, default 25)

get.description: Returns newly chartered Rotaract clubs in South Asia (126 clubs chartered in the current 2026 period) with charter dates, initial members, and sponsor Rotary clubs.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Number of records to return (1-100, default 25)

parameters.name: atRiskOnly

200.description: Paginated list of clubs in arrears

get.description: Retrieves giving statistics, Annual Fund contributions, and PolioPlus donations per club.
Global totals, country growth leaderboards, district rankings, and new club charter statistics. Supports sorting and filtering to find top-performing districts globally.
Returns the verification challenge token for registering MCP plugins on the OpenAI platform.
Returns the Model Context Protocol (MCP) server metadata, protocol version, capabilities, and the full schema definitions for all 14 available AI tools.

200.description: Tool execution result wrapped in JSON-RPC 2.0

get.description: Returns clubs that simultaneously have both outstanding financial arrears AND missing officer reports (highest aggregate compliance risk, 761 clubs).
Returns comprehensive Interact club analytics across South Asia: 8,921 total clubs, 735 suspended, 137 clubs sponsored by 65 Rotaract clubs, plus district/zone growth trends.
Lists all Rotaract clubs belonging to a specific district with filtering, sorting, and pagination.
